user_message_en: My water broke with a large gush of clear fluid, but I am only 33 weeks pregnant and having no pain.

user_message_en: My stomach is rock hard and constantly painful, and I am bleeding dark blood at 35 weeks.

user_message_en: My one-week-old baby's umbilical cord is red, swollen, smells terrible, and is oozing yellow pus.
reply_en: EMERGENCY: Severe redness, swelling, and foul-smelling pus around the umbilical cord base indicate severe omphalitis (umbilical cord infection). This infection can spread rapidly into the baby's bloodstream causing sepsis. Take your baby to a hospital emergency unit immediately.

user_message_en: My baby was born 2 days ago and is completely yellow all over, including the palms of the hands and soles of the feet.
reply_en: EMERGENCY: Jaundice that extends to the baby's palms and soles within the first few days of life is severe and can cause permanent brain injury (kernicterus). Your baby requires urgent serum bilirubin testing and immediate phototherapy at a hospital.

user_message_en: My 2-week-old baby feels very cold to touch and has a low temperature of 35 degrees despite being wrapped.
reply_en: EMERGENCY: A body temperature below 36.0°C (hypothermia) in a newborn is dangerous and frequently signals a severe infection or metabolic failure. Place the baby skin-to-skin against your chest covered with a warm blanket, and transport immediately to a health facility.

user_message_pcm: I deliver 4 days ago and suddenly soaking big pad in less than 30 minutes with big blood clots.

user_message_en: My baby has a high fever, stiff neck, and cries in agonizing pain whenever I touch or move his head.
reply_en: EMERGENCY: High fever combined with neck stiffness and severe irritability is a hallmark sign of acute bacterial meningitis. This requires immediate lumbar puncture, blood cultures, and intravenous antibiotics at an emergency hospital today.

reply_yo: EMERGENCY: Ibà tó ga pẹ̀lú ọrùn líle àti ìrora líle lásìkò tí a bá gbé orí jẹ́ àmì pàtàkì ti àkóràn ọpọlọ (acute bacterial meningitis). Èyí nílò àyẹ̀wò ẹ̀jẹ̀ àti omi ẹ̀yìn lẹ́sẹ̀kẹsẹ̀ pẹ̀lú oògùn apakòkòrò alábẹ́rẹ́ ní ilé-ìwòsàn lónìí.
user_message_pcm: My baby get high fever, stiff neck, and dey cry heavy pain anytime I touch or move the head.
reply_pcm: EMERGENCY: High fever combined with stiff neck and serious crying pain is a major sign of acute bacterial meningitis. This requires immediate hospital admission, spinal fluid check, and IV antibiotics at emergency hospital today.

user_message_en: My 7-month-old infant is making a harsh whistling sound when breathing in and cannot swallow his own saliva.
reply_en: EMERGENCY: Inspiratory whistling (stridor) and inability to swallow saliva point to acute upper airway obstruction (such as severe croup, epiglottitis, or foreign body aspiration). Keep the child calm and upright, and seek emergency hospital care immediately.

reply_yo: EMERGENCY: Ìdún fèrè mímú lásìkò mímí (stridor) àti àìlè gbé itọ́ mì ń fi ìdènà líle ní ọ̀nà èémí òkè hàn (bí croup, epiglottitis, tàbí ohun kan tó há sọ́fun). Ẹ jẹ́ kí ọmọ wà ní ìbalẹ̀ ọkàn ní ìjókòó, kí ẹ sì wá ìtọ́jú pàjáwìrì ní ilé-ìwòsàn lẹ́sẹ̀kẹsẹ̀.
user_message_pcm: My 7-month-old baby dey make sharp whistling sound when breathing in and cannot swallow saliva.
reply_pcm: EMERGENCY: Whistling sound when breathing in (stridor) and inability to swallow saliva point to blocked upper windpipe (like severe croup or swallowed object). Keep child calm, sit upright, and rush to emergency hospital immediately.

user_message_en: I am 10 days postpartum and suddenly experiencing unilateral severe calf swelling, redness, and pain when walking.
reply_en: EMERGENCY: Sudden painful swelling and redness in one calf postpartum are typical signs of Deep Vein Thrombosis (DVT), a blood clot that can travel to the lungs (pulmonary embolism). Avoid massaging the leg and go to an emergency hospital department immediately.

reply_yo: EMERGENCY: Wíwú pẹ̀lú ìrora àti pípọ́n ní ẹsẹ̀ kan ṣoṣo lẹ́yìn ìbímọ jẹ́ àmì dídì ẹ̀jẹ̀ nínú iṣan ẹsẹ̀ (Deep Vein Thrombosis, DVT), èyí tí ó lè gba inú ẹ̀jẹ̀ lọ sí ẹ̀dọ̀fóró. Ẹ yẹra fún fífọwọ́ pa ẹsẹ̀ náà, ẹ lọ sí ẹ̀ka pàjáwìrì ilé-ìwòsàn lẹ́sẹ̀kẹsẹ̀.
user_message_pcm: I deliver 10 days ago and suddenly one leg calf swell up, turn red, and dey pain me to walk.
reply_pcm: EMERGENCY: Sudden painful swelling and redness in one calf postpartum are typical signs of Deep Vein Thrombosis (blood clot), wey fit travel to lungs. Avoid massaging the leg at all and go to emergency hospital immediately.

Take your child's immunization card to your primary health centre this week.

reply_yo: PRIORITY: Ní ọ̀sẹ̀ 6, ọmọ rẹ ti tó àkókò fún ìbẹ̀wò àjẹsára àkọ́kọ́ ti àwọn àrùn púpọ̀ lábẹ́ ètò Nàìjíríà: Pentavalent 1 (fún ikọ́ aṣebí, tetanus, hep B, hib), PCV 1 (fún pneumonia), OPV 1 (oògùn rọpárọsẹ̀ ẹnu), àti Rotavirus 1 (fún ìgbẹ́ gbuuru). user_message_en: My baby had a mild fever and crankiness for one day after getting the 6-week injection. Is that dangerous?

Dress the baby in light clothing, continue frequent breastfeeding, and apply a cool damp cloth to the injection site. If fever exceeds 38.5°C or persists past 48 hours, visit your health centre.

user_message_en: Can I give cough syrup to my 4-month-old baby who has a running nose?
reply_en: PRIORITY: Over-the-counter cough and cold syrups should NEVER be given to infants under 2 years old, as they can cause severe sedation, respiratory depression, and death. Clean congested nostrils with normal saline drops and continue frequent breastfeeding. Consult your health clinic if cough persists.

reply_yo: PRIORITY: A kò gbọ́dọ̀ fún ọmọdé tí kò tíì pé ọdún 2 ní oògùn ikọ́ àti òtútù láé, nítorí wọ́n lè fa kí ọmọ sùn kọjá ààlà, dẹ́kun mímí, tàbí ikú. Ẹ fi omi iyọ̀ fẹ́lẹ́fẹ́lẹ́ (saline drops) nu imú rẹ̀ kí ẹ sì máa fún un ní ọmú dáadáa. Ẹ lọ sí ilé-ìlera bí ikọ́ bá tẹ̀síwájú.
user_message_pcm: I fit give cough syrup to my 4-month-old baby wey get running nose?
reply_pcm: PRIORITY: Over-the-counter cough and cold syrups should NEVER be given to children under 2 years old, as they can cause severe sleepiness, breathing stoppage, and death. Clean blocked nose with normal saline drops and continue breastfeeding. Consult clinic if cough persist.

user_message_en: My 5-month-old baby pulls on his right ear constantly, cries during feeds, and has fluid draining from the ear.
reply_en: PRIORITY: Ear tugging, irritability, and ear drainage suggest acute otitis media (middle ear infection). Do not insert cotton buds or oil into the ear canal. Please take your baby to a primary health centre this week for otoscopic examination and appropriate oral antibiotics.

reply_yo: PRIORITY: Fífa etí, ẹkún lásìkò ọmú, àti omi tó ń jáde láti etí ń fi àkóràn inú etí hàn (otitis media). Ẹ má ti owú tàbí epo bọ inú etí rárá. Ẹ gbé ọmọ lọ sí ilé-ìlera àkọ́bẹ̀rẹ̀ ní ọ̀sẹ̀ yìí fún àyẹ̀wò etí àti oògùn apakòkòrò tó tọ́.
user_message_pcm: My 5-month-old baby dey pull his right ear constantly, dey cry during feeds, and water dey commot from the ear.
reply_pcm: PRIORITY: Ear pulling, crying, and ear discharge show middle ear infection (otitis media). Do not insert cotton buds or oil into the ear canal. Please take your baby to health centre this week for doctor check and proper oral antibiotics.

user_message_en: We missed our baby's 10-week immunization visit by over a month. Do we start all the injections over again?
reply_en: PRIORITY: No, you never need to restart the vaccine schedule from the beginning! Your baby retains immune memory from previous doses. Visit your nearest health facility this week to receive the second doses (Penta 2, PCV 2, OPV 2, Rota 2) and resume the regular schedule.

user_message_en: What vaccines are scheduled for an infant at 14 weeks of age in Nigeria?
reply_en: PRIORITY: At 14 weeks, infants receive Pentavalent 3, PCV 3, Oral Polio Vaccine 3 (OPV 3), and Inactivated Polio Vaccine (IPV 1 injection). Completing these doses gives essential immunity against diphtheria, tetanus, whooping cough, hepatitis B, Hib, pneumococcus, and polio.

user_message_pcm: Which vaccines dem schedule for baby at 14 weeks of age in Nigeria?
reply_pcm: PRIORITY: At 14 weeks, infants receive Pentavalent 3, PCV 3, Oral Polio Vaccine 3 (OPV 3), and Inactivated Polio Vaccine (IPV 1 injection). Completing these doses gives strong protection against diphtheria, tetanus, whooping cough, hepatitis B, Hib, pneumonia, and polio.

reply_en: PRIORITY: By 4 months, most infants exhibit social smiling, visually track objects, and respond to voices. Absence of social smile or lack of reaction to sounds may indicate hearing, vision, or developmental delays. Request a developmental evaluation at your primary care clinic.

user_message_en: I want to start a family planning method while breastfeeding my 7-week-old baby. What options are safe?
reply_en: PRIORITY: Progestin-only contraceptives (such as the subdermal implant, progestin injection like DMPA, or progestin-only pills), intrauterine devices (IUDs), and condoms are safe during breastfeeding because they do not reduce milk supply. Visit your local family planning clinic to choose the best option.

user_message_en: Can I give pure natural honey to my 8-month-old baby to sweeten his porridge?
reply_en: ROUTINE: No! Never give honey to an infant under 12 months of age, whether raw or cooked. Honey can contain Clostridium botulinum spores that produce deadly toxins in an infant's immature gut, causing infant botulism, muscle paralysis, and respiratory failure.

reply_yo: ROUTINE: Rárá o! Ẹ má ṣe fún ọmọ tí kò tíì pé ọdún kan ní oyin láé, yálà tútù tàbí èyí tí a bọ̀. Oyin lè ní àwọn kòkòrò Clostridium botulinum tí ń pèsè májèlé nínú ìfun ọmọ kékeré, èyí tí ó lè fa àìlera ẹran-ara (botulism), rọpárọsẹ̀, àti àìlèwí.
user_message_pcm: I fit give pure natural honey to my 8-month-old baby to sweeten his pap?

user_message_en: When should I introduce solid foods to my baby, and what foods should I start with?
reply_en: ROUTINE: Complementary feeding begins at exactly 6 months while continuing breastfeeding. Start with thick, smooth enriched porridges (e.g., maize/guinea corn pap enriched with ground crayfish, soya flour, egg yolk, or milk powder) and mashed fruits/vegetables like ripe banana or papaya.

user_message_en: Why is watery, thin corn pap alone not adequate for a 7-month-old baby?
reply_en: ROUTINE: Plain corn pap (ogi/koko) is mostly water and carbohydrates with very little protein, iron, zinc, or vitamins. Rapidly growing infants need nutrient-dense meals. Always enrich pap with ground fish, crayfish, beans, egg, or milk to prevent malnutrition and stunting.
user_message_yo: Kí nìdí tí ẹ̀kọ omi lásán kò fi tó fún ọmọ ọlọ́ṣù 7?
reply_yo: ROUTINE: Ẹ̀kọ omi lásán jẹ́ omi àti èròjà carbohydrate púpọ̀ láìsí amúnidàgbà (protein), iron, zinc, tàbí àwọn vitamin tó tó. Àwọn ọmọ tí ń dàgbà ní kánkán nílò oúnjẹ tó kún fún aṣaralóore. Ẹ máa da ẹja, èdè, ẹ̀wà, ẹyin, tàbí wàrà sí ẹ̀kọ rẹ̀ ní gbogbo ìgbà láti dènà àìjẹunrekéte àti àìdàgbà ọmọ.
user_message_pcm: Why watery light corn pap alone no dey enough for 7-month-old baby?
reply_pcm: ROUTINE: Plain watery corn pap (ogi/koko) na mostly water and carbohydrates with very little protein, iron, zinc, or vitamins. Rapidly growing babies need food wey get heavy nutrition. Always mix pap with ground fish, crayfish, beans, egg, or milk to prevent malnutrition and stunting.
notes: Routine: Nutrient density of complementary foods.

user_message_en: How many times a day should an 8-month-old breastfed infant eat complementary meals?
reply_en: ROUTINE: A breastfed infant aged 6–8 months should receive complementary meals 2 to 3 times a day, increasing to 3 to 4 meals a day with 1 to 2 nutritious snacks (like fruit) between 9 and 23 months, alongside on-demand breastfeeding.

reply_yo: ROUTINE: Ọmọ tí ń mu ọmú tó wà láàárín oṣù 6 sí 8 gbọ́dọ̀ jẹ oúnjẹ àfikún ní ẹ̀ẹ̀mejì sí ẹ̀ẹ̀mẹ́ta lójúmọ́, èyí tí yóò di ẹ̀ẹ̀mẹ́ta sí mẹ́rin lójúmọ́ pẹ̀lú oúnjẹ fẹ́lẹ́fẹ́lẹ́ (bí èso) lẹ́ẹ̀kan sí méjì nígbà tí ó bá wà láàárín oṣù 9 sí 23, pẹ̀lú fífún ní ọmú léraléra.

reply_en: ROUTINE: At 9 months of age, your infant should receive the first Measles vaccine dose (Measles 1), the Yellow Fever vaccine, and the Meningococcal A vaccine (Men A). These protect against severe childhood epidemics.

reply_en: ROUTINE: No. Covering a stroller or pram with a blanket or cloth creates a greenhouse effect, trapping heat and causing temperatures inside to rise dangerously high within minutes, leading to heatstroke and SIDS. Use a dedicated clip-on sun parasol or canopy that maintains open airflow.
